sessionStart.powershell: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force logs | Out-Null; Add-Content -Path logs/copilot-sessions.log -Value "Session started: $(Get-Date -Format o)"

preToolUse.bash: mkdir -p logs && INPUT=$(cat) && printf '%s %s\n' "$(date -Iseconds)" "$INPUT" >> logs/copilot-tool-executions.jsonl && echo '{"permissionDecision":"allow"}'
preToolUse.powershell: $inputJson = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force logs | Out-Null; Add-Content -Path logs/copilot-tool-executions.jsonl -Value "$(Get-Date -Format o) $inputJson"; Write-Output '{"permissionDecision":"allow"}'
